why: Anchoring on the turret makes the target chase the barrel: the aim-hold layer sees a solution that moves every tick as the turret slews toward it, breaks its hold and re-solves, reintroducing the per-tick chasing issue #344 removed. The bound also stops meaning anything, since it is then measured from a moving reference.
killedBy: idle turret search heading does not move when only the TURRET moves
idle turret search heading stays inside the sweep of the HULL angle, at every tick of a long run
